title: Five
summary: 五子棋，支持 Rapfi、同机双人和房间码联机。 Gomoku with Rapfi, local and LAN play.
description:
简体中文
在 Cardputer Zero 上下五子棋。可与 Rapfi 对弈，选择三档难度，也可在同一台设备轮流落子。联机时，Zero 和浏览器都可创建房间，用 10 位房间码加入。同一局域网内可双 Zero、双网页或混合对战，电脑无需安装或运行额外程序。支持 15×15 和 13×13 棋盘、自由规则与连珠禁手，界面提供简体中文和英文。联机配对需要互联网连接，对局在局域网内直连。网页版：https://fivezero.vercel.app/ 连珠禁手可按需显示禁手点，并选择禁止落子或直接判负。

最近改动（1.2.1-1）
新增菜单音效，与落子音效共用「音效」开关。连珠禁手可选择实时标记黑棋禁手点，默认关闭。默认禁止落子，也可设为黑棋直接判负。

English
Play Gomoku against Rapfi at three difficulty levels, take turns on one Cardputer Zero, or play over your LAN. Either a Zero or a browser can host or join using a 10-digit room code. The browser needs no extra software. Choose a 15×15 or 13×13 board with Freestyle or Renju fouls. The interface supports Simplified Chinese and English. Pairing requires internet access. Moves travel directly between players on the LAN. Web app: https://fivezero.vercel.app/ Renju offers forbidden-point markers and a choice of blocking foul moves or counting them as a loss.

What’s new (1.2.1-1)
One sound setting controls menus and moves. In Renju, optionally mark forbidden points on Black’s turn. Forbidden moves are blocked by default, with an option to count them as an immediate loss for Black.

许可 / Licenses
Five 采用 GPL-3.0-or-later。Rapfi 引擎采用 GPL-3.0-or-later，模型权重采用 CC0-1.0，安装包附有对应的 Rapfi 源码与构建脚本。
Five and the bundled Rapfi engine are licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Rapfi model weights use CC0-1.0. The package includes Rapfi’s corresponding source and build script.
